title: cenchrus tripsacoides
intro: Cenchrus tripsacoides, commonly known as Proso millet or Cheval (French for 'wild horse' due to its habit of being grazed by horses), is a small grassy plant native to tropical and subtropical regions. The health benefits of Cenchrus tripsacoides include its potential in lowering cholesterol levels and managing type 2 diabetes due to its richness in fiber and nutrients. The therapeutic actions of this plant are believed to be due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help in soothing digestive issues and alleviating symptoms of anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Cenchrus tripsacoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
